parse.title: Pay-to-play Runecraft training

===Levels 1–32/34: Questing===
Early levels can be almost completely skipped by completing [[Quest experience rewards#Runecraft|quests that give Runecraft experience]]. This allows the player to craft [[lava rune]]s or do the [[Guardians of the Rift]] [[Minigames|minigame]].

At level 32, it's recommended to train to level 35, and then complete [[What Lies Below]], for an 8,000 Runecrafting experience reward.

[[Lunar Diplomacy]] grants an additional 5,000 experience, as does [[Perilous Moons]]. However, they both have fairly high requirements. Note that completing Lunar Diplomacy is eventually recommended, as being on the [[Lunar spellbook]] is highly recommended for crafting lava runes and for [[Ourania Altar]].
